messages:
maria: Quick sync for Forge Edge preview access packet. We need NDA + telemetry contract finalized before we hand over the beta board. Goal: kit in partner lab next Wed.
ajay: Legal got the draft yesterday, I'm chasing a few clarifications about embargo windows and allowed derivative benchmarks. Expect partner counsel feedback by tomorrow morning.
kevin: On the telemetry side, can we standardize the artifact layout? I propose: `artifact.tar.gz` containing `metrics.jsonl` (per-iteration), `system_counters.csv`, `gpu_mem.log`, `run.sh`, and `checksums.txt`. This keeps ingestion simple.
sylvia: Packaging note: marketplace uses an optimized image. We'll need a runtime image (~1.2GB compressed), Dockerfile, and a manifest of kernel/driver reqs. Forge uses a vendor kernel patch, so list that explicitly.
maria: Good. Also need to pick embargo tiers: internal preview (team-only) 21 days, partner-only embargo 45 days, public press embargo 75 days post-GA. Ajay, can legal approve those ranges?
ajay: 21 internal is fine. We typically push for 60 partner embargo; 45 is negotiable if partner accepts stricter publication controls. I'll surface both options to counsel.
nolan: Logistics: lab kit ready, shipping label created. I'll only release SSH creds after signed NDA and agreed bench spec received. Courier ETA Thu.
kevin: For the run script, here's a sample command line we want partners to run (include in appendix):
```
./run_preview_bench.sh --model redwood-lite-8b --seq-len 1024 --batch 2 --warmup 50 --iters 500 --emit jsonl --trace-kv
```
kevin: Also ask Forge to capture `/proc/interrupts` and our provided `hw_diag.sh` output for correlating interrupts to latency spikes.
sylvia: Marketing needs a 150-word blurb and high-res logo + trademark approval to start marketplace draft. I'll open a PR for assets.
maria: Action list: ajay 1 follow up with counsel on embargo windows and counters; kevin 1 finalize artifact layout + put run script in a gist; sylvia 1 start marketplace asset PR and kernel/driver checklist; nolan 1 hold provisioning until NDA scanned to our SharePoint. I'll draft the partner-facing packet after kevin's gist.
forge-infra-bot: Notice: partner lab slot reserved 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-19. Auto-reminder scheduled 72h before access.
ajay: I'll include a clause for joint announcement approvals and a 3-person signoff process for any public benchmark release.
maria: That signoff process works. Also propose we include a short eval harness and seed prompts so partner runs are comparable. Kevin, can you add a minimal prompt set?
kevin: Yep. I'll add `prompts_seed.txt` to the artifact and a README describing metric units and rounding rules.
sylvia: Also checklist item: compliance cert matrix (FIPS, PCI, SOC2) preferences from Forge. I tagged the partner PM to collect that.
nolan: Courier tracking: XJS-998234 posted, will update when scanned.
maria: Thanks. Please keep all bench numbers confined to this channel until embargo is agreed. We'll reconvene after legal reply. :lock:
kevin: ack — I'll standardize metric names (e.g., throughput_tps, latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms) so we can ingest automatically.
sylvia: pinging @marketing-team @legal-team to standby for the packet.
maria: End — I'll paste NDA counters when they arrive and update shipping hold status.
